_readme: Every {{TOKEN}} in src/ is replaced from this file at build time. This is the
'set it once' file site-content.md asks for: a rename or a price change is one
edit here, not a crawl through markup.
PRODUCT was a literal placeholder until Aug 16 2026, then Dogear, and is
Vellum as of Aug 17 2026 (owner decision, superseding the Dogear row in
Project-Rascal docs/decisions.md). Dogear was abandoned because the name was
occupied on the App Store, Google Play and the Chrome Web Store by a cluster
of book-tracking apps, and both thedogearapp.com and getdogear.com were
already live -- see seo-plan.md.
Vellum's clearance status is disputed as of Aug 18 2026: the owner says it
was checked and is fine; a separate open item says no search has been run.
Neither came with a search to point at. Vellum by 180g is a live software
trademark in a publishing-adjacent category (book formatting for authors).
That unresolved question is why this is still a token and not a hardcoded
string: if the name moves again, it moves here and nowhere else.
DOMAIN and ORIGIN were placeholders until Aug 18 2026, when getvellumapp.com
was registered and pointed here. Setting them is what switches on
self-referencing canonicals, absolute OG image URLs, the Organization url,
sitemap.xml and the Pages CNAME -- none of which shipped while the origin was
a guess. Nothing else needs to change: SUPPORT_EMAIL is built from DOMAIN, and
the deploy reads the CNAME the build emits.
Buying the domain is not a trademark clearance. The Vellum question above is
still open, and a registrar will happily sell you a name somebody else owns
the mark for. If the name moves, DOMAIN and ORIGIN move with it, here.
_price_note: The bare numbers are the source and the display strings are derived, so a
price change is still one edit. Added Aug 21 2026 because layout.html's
SoftwareApplication JSON-LD carried a hardcoded "price": "59.99" -- schema.org
wants a number with no currency symbol, so the display token could not be
used there and somebody typed the figure instead. It agreed with PRICE_YEAR
at the time, which is the whole problem with a second copy: it is right
until the day it is silently wrong, in machine-readable data on every page.
_trial_note: Was TRIAL_DAYS = 'Fourteen', rendered as 'Fourteen days free'. Replaced
Aug 21 2026 with the trial's own phrasing, because the sharp fact about it
is not its length -- it is that there is no card and therefore nothing to
cancel, and 'two weeks' is the wording the owner-approved app copy uses for
the same screen. Lowercase on purpose: it reads mid-sentence everywhere it
appears, so no page starts a sentence with it.
CTA_SUPPORT: One a day, by email. A note when it opens and when the price goes live. Nothing else.
_cta_note: CTA describes the outcome, which is only honest if the daily waitlist email
actually ships. If it doesn't: set CTA to 'Join the waitlist' and CTA_SUPPORT
to "We'll email when it opens and when pricing goes live. Nothing else."
That is the whole revert -- both strings live here and nowhere else.
_social_note: The five SOCIAL_* profile tokens are gone, Aug 21 2026, and so is the footer
column that rendered them. They held the bare platform domains -- a link
labelled Instagram that went to instagram.com is a link to somebody else's
home page wearing our label, which is worse than no link. The old note here
said 'no account exists yet' and that is now half wrong: an Instagram
account does exist and this repository posts to it hourly. What does not
exist anywhere in this repository is its HANDLE -- social-post.mjs addresses
it by the numeric IG_USER_ID secret, and a published row records a mediaId
with no permalink, so nothing here could be read to produce a profile URL.
Guessing one is exactly the dead link the removal exists to prevent.
To put it back: add one key per REAL account (SOCIAL_INSTAGRAM = the full
https://www.instagram.com/<handle> URL, verified by opening it), then the
foot__col block whose removal is commented in src/partials/footer.html.
One key, one link -- do not restore a platform whose account does not exist.
They stay out of the Organization sameAs in layout.html until then: a footer
link a reader can shrug at is not the same as telling a crawler, in
machine-readable terms, that a profile IS this product.
_prompt_count_note: Two counts, both checked by scripts/prompts.mjs against the generated
library, which exits non-zero if either drifts. QUESTION_COUNT is new on
Aug 21 2026 and exists because the free tier now serves the daily question
only: the prompts page has to be able to say how many of the published
prompts a free account actually receives without hardcoding the number in
markup. The remainder -- PROMPT_COUNT minus QUESTION_COUNT -- is the
missions, and no page states that difference as its own literal.
